   395→// handleClaudeCodePostTodo handles the PostToolUse[TodoWrite] hook for subagent checkpoints.
   396→// Creates a checkpoint if we're in a subagent context (active pre-task file exists).
   397→// Skips silently if not in subagent context (main agent).
   398→func handleClaudeCodePostTodo() error {
   399→	input, err := parseSubagentCheckpointHookInput(os.Stdin)
   400→	if err != nil {
   401→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[TodoWrite] input: %w", err)
   402→	}
   403→
   404→	// Get agent for logging context
   405→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   406→	if err != nil {
   407→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   408→	}
   409→
   410→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   411→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-todo",
   412→		slog.String("hook", "post-todo"),
   413→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   414→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   415→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.TranscriptPath),
   416→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   417→	)
   418→
   419→	// Check if we're in a subagent context by looking for an active pre-task file
   420→	taskToolUseID, found := FindActivePreTaskFile()
   421→	if !found {
   422→		// Not in subagent context - this is a main agent TodoWrite, skip
   423→		return nil
   424→	}
   425→
   426→	// Skip on default branch to avoid polluting main/master history
   427→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranch(); skip {
   428→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping incremental checkpoint on branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   429→		return nil
   430→	}
   431→
   432→	// Detect file changes since last checkpoint
   433→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(nil)
   434→	if err != nil {
   435→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to detect changed files: %v\n", err)
   436→		return nil
   437→	}
   438→
   439→	// If no file changes, skip creating a checkpoint
   440→	if len(changes.Modified) == 0 && len(changes.New) == 0 && len(changes.Deleted) == 0 {
   441→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] No file changes detected, skipping incremental checkpoint\n")
   442→		return nil
   443→	}
   444→
   445→	// Get git author
   446→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   447→	if err != nil {
   448→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to get git author: %v\n", err)
   449→		return nil
   450→	}
   451→
   452→	// Get the active strategy
   453→	strat := GetStrategy()
   454→
   455→	// Ensure strategy setup is complete
   456→	if err := strat.EnsureSetup(); err != nil {
   457→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to ensure strategy setup: %v\n", err)
   458→		return nil
   459→	}
   460→
   461→	// Get the session ID from the transcript path or input, then transform to Entire session ID
   462→	sessionID := input.SessionID
   463→	if sessionID == "" {
   464→		sessionID = paths.ExtractSessionIDFromTranscriptPath(input.TranscriptPath)
   465→	}
   466→
   467→	// Get next checkpoint sequence
   468→	seq := GetNextCheckpointSequence(sessionID, taskToolUseID)
   469→
   470→	// Extract the todo content from the tool_input.
   471→	// PostToolUse receives the NEW todo list where the just-completed work is
   472→	// marked as "completed". The last completed item is the work that was just done.
   473→	todoContent := ExtractLastCompletedTodoFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   474→	if todoContent == "" {
   475→		// No completed items - this is likely the first TodoWrite (planning phase).
   476→		// Check if there are any todos at all to avoid duplicate messages.
   477→		todoCount := CountTodosFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   478→		if todoCount > 0 {
   479→			// Use "Planning: N todos" format for the first TodoWrite
   480→			todoContent = fmt.Sprintf("Planning: %d todos", todoCount)
   481→		}
   482→		// If todoCount == 0, todoContent remains empty and FormatIncrementalMessage
   483→		// will fall back to "Checkpoint #N" format
   484→	}
   485→
   486→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   487→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   488→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   489→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   490→	}
   491→
   492→	// Build incremental checkpoint context
   493→	ctx := strategy.TaskCheckpointContext{
   494→		SessionID:           sessionID,
   495→		ToolUseID:           taskToolUseID,
   496→		ModifiedFiles:       changes.Modified,
   497→		NewFiles:            changes.New,
   498→		DeletedFiles:        changes.Deleted,
   499→		TranscriptPath:      input.TranscriptPath,
   500→		AuthorName:          author.Name,
   501→		AuthorEmail:         author.Email,
   502→		IsIncremental:       true,
   503→		IncrementalSequence: seq,
   504→		IncrementalType:     input.ToolName,
   505→		IncrementalData:     input.ToolInput,
   506→		TodoContent:         todoContent,
   507→		AgentType:           agentType,
   508→	}
   509→
   510→	// Save incremental checkpoint
   511→	if err := strat.SaveTaskCheckpoint(ctx); err != nil {
   512→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to save incremental checkpoint: %v\n", err)
   513→		return nil
   514→	}
   515→
   516→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Created incremental checkpoint #%d for %s (task: %s)\n",
   517→		seq, input.ToolName, taskToolUseID[:min(12, len(taskToolUseID))])
   518→	return nil
   519→}

   557→// handleClaudeCodePostTask handles the PostToolUse[Task] hook
   558→func handleClaudeCodePostTask() error {
   559→	input, err := parsePostTaskHookInput(os.Stdin)
   560→	if err != nil {
   561→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[Task] input: %w", err)
   562→	}
   563→
   564→	// Extract subagent type from tool_input for logging
   565→	subagentType, taskDescription := ParseSubagentTypeAndDescription(input.ToolInput)
   566→
   567→	// Get agent for logging context
   568→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   569→	if err != nil {
   570→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   571→	}
   572→
   573→	// Log parsed input context
   574→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   575→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-task",
   576→		slog.String("hook", "post-task"),
   577→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   578→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   579→		slog.String("agent_id", input.AgentID),
   580→		slog.String("subagent_type", subagentType),
   581→	)
   582→
   583→	// Determine subagent transcript path
   584→	transcriptDir := filepath.Dir(input.TranscriptPath)
   585→	var subagentTranscriptPath string
   586→	if input.AgentID != "" {
   587→		subagentTranscriptPath = AgentTranscriptPath(transcriptDir, input.AgentID)
   588→		if !fileExists(subagentTranscriptPath) {
   589→			subagentTranscriptPath = ""
   590→		}
   591→	}
   592→
   593→	// Log context to stdout
   594→	logPostTaskHookContext(os.Stdout, input, subagentTranscriptPath)
   595→
   596→	// Parse transcript to extract modified files
   597→	var modifiedFiles []string
   598→	if subagentTranscriptPath != "" {
   599→		// Use subagent transcript if available

   797→// waitForTranscriptFlush polls the transcript file tail for the hook_progress
   798→// sentinel entry that Claude Code writes when launching the stop hook.
   799→// Once this entry appears in the file, all prior entries (assistant replies,
   800→// tool results) are guaranteed to have been flushed.
   801→//
   802→// hookStartTime is the approximate time our process started, used to avoid
   803→// matching stale sentinel entries from previous stop hook invocations.
   804→//
   805→// Falls back silently after a timeout — the transcript copy will proceed
   806→// with whatever data is available.
   807→func waitForTranscriptFlush(transcriptPath string, hookStartTime time.Time) {
   808→	const (
   809→		maxWait      = 3 * time.Second
   810→		pollInterval = 50 * time.Millisecond
   811→		tailBytes    = 4096 // Read last 4KB — sentinel is near the end
   812→		maxSkew      = 2 * time.Second
   813→	)
   814→
   815→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks")
   816→	deadline := time.Now().Add(maxWait)
   817→	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
   818→		if checkStopSentinel(transcriptPath, tailBytes, hookStartTime, maxSkew) {
   819→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "transcript flush sentinel found",
   820→				slog.Duration("wait", time.Since(hookStartTime)),
   821→			)
   822→			return
   823→		}
   824→		time.Sleep(pollInterval)
   825→	}
   826→	// Timeout — proceed with whatever is on disk.
   827→	logging.Warn(logCtx, "transcript flush sentinel not found within timeout, proceeding",
   828→		slog.Duration("timeout", maxWait),
   829→	)
   830→}

   832→// checkStopSentinel reads the tail of the transcript file and looks for a
   833→// hook_progress entry containing the stop hook sentinel, with a timestamp
   834→// close to hookStartTime.
   835→func checkStopSentinel(path string, tailBytes int64, hookStartTime time.Time, maxSkew time.Duration) bool {
   836→	f, err := os.Open(path) //nolint:gosec // path comes from agent hook input
   837→	if err != nil {
   838→		return false
   839→	}
   840→	defer f.Close()
   841→
   842→	// Seek to tail
   843→	info, err := f.Stat()
   844→	if err != nil {
   845→		return false
   846→	}
   847→	offset := info.Size() - tailBytes
   848→	if offset < 0 {
   849→		offset = 0
   850→	}
   851→	buf := make([]byte, info.Size()-offset)
   852→	if _, err := f.ReadAt(buf, offset); err != nil {
   853→		return false
   854→	}
   855→
   856→	// Scan lines from the tail for the sentinel
   857→	lines := strings.Split(string(buf), "\n")
   858→	for _, line := range lines {
   859→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   860→		if line == "" || !strings.Contains(line, stopHookSentinel) {
   861→			continue
   862→		}
   863→
   864→		// Parse timestamp to check recency
   865→		var entry struct {
   866→			Timestamp string `json:"timestamp"`
   867→		}
   868→		if json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry) != nil || entry.Timestamp == "" {
   869→			continue
   870→		}
   871→		ts, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, entry.Timestamp)
   872→		if err != nil {
   873→			ts, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, entry.Timestamp)
   874→			if err != nil {
   875→				continue
   876→			}
   877→		}
   878→
   879→		// Check timestamp is within skew window of our start time
   880→		if ts.After(hookStartTime.Add(-maxSkew)) && ts.Before(hookStartTime.Add(maxSkew)) {
   881→			return true
   882→		}
   883→	}
   884→	return false
   885→}

I found the bug. In `PostCommit`, `sessionHasNewContent` calls `sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript` which uses `getStagedFiles(repo)` to check for file overlap. But in PostCommit, there are no staged files because the commit has already been made!

For ACTIVE sessions in PostCommit, the commit already has a checkpoint trailer (verified at line 487), which means PrepareCommitMsg already determined the commit was related to the session. We should trust that for ACTIVE sessions.

    32→//
    33→// In test environments, ENTIRE_TEST_TTY overrides the real check:
    34→//   - ENTIRE_TEST_TTY=1 → simulate human (TTY available)
    35→//   - ENTIRE_TEST_TTY=0 → simulate agent (no TTY)
    36→func hasTTY() bool {
    37→	if v := os.Getenv("ENTIRE_TEST_TTY"); v != "" {
    38→		return v == "1"
    39→	}
    40→	tty, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
    41→	if err != nil {
    42→		return false
    43→	}
    44→	_ = tty.Close()
    45→	return true
    46→}
    47→
    48→// askConfirmTTY prompts the user for a yes/no confirmation via /dev/tty.
    49→// This works even when stdin is redirected (e.g., git commit -m).
    50→// Returns true for yes, false for no. If TTY is unavailable, returns the default.
    51→// If context is non-empty, it is displayed on a separate line before the prompt.
    52→func askConfirmTTY(prompt string, context string, defaultYes bool) bool {
    53→	// In test mode, don't try to interact with the real TTY — just use the default.
    54→	// ENTIRE_TEST_TTY=1 simulates "a human is present" for the hasTTY() check
    55→	// but we can't actually read from the TTY in tests.
    56→	if os.Getenv("ENTIRE_TEST_TTY") != "" {
    57→		return defaultYes
    58→	}
    59→
    60→	// Open /dev/tty for both reading and writing
    61→	// This is the controlling terminal, which works even when stdin/stderr are redirected
    62→	tty, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
    63→	if err != nil {
    64→		// Can't open TTY (e.g., running in CI), use default
    65→		return defaultYes
    66→	}
    67→	defer tty.Close()
    68→
    69→	// Show context if provided
    70→	if context != "" {
    71→		fmt.Fprintf(tty, "%s\n", context)
    72→	}
    73→
    74→	// Show prompt with default indicator
    75→	// Write to tty directly, not stderr, since git hooks may redirect stderr to /dev/null
    76→	var hint string
    77→	if defaultYes {
    78→		hint = "[Y/n]"
    79→	} else {
    80→		hint = "[y/N]"
    81→	}
    82→	fmt.Fprintf(tty, "%s %s ", prompt, hint)
    83→
    84→	// Read response
    85→	reader := bufio.NewReader(tty)
    86→	response, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
    87→	if err != nil {
    88→		return defaultYes
    89→	}
    90→
    91→	response = strings.TrimSpace(strings.ToLower(response))
    92→	switch response {
    93→	case "y", "yes":
    94→		return true
    95→	case "n", "no":
    96→		return false
    97→	default:
    98→		// Empty or invalid input - use default
    99→		return defaultYes
   100→	}
   101→}

   103→// CommitMsg is called by the git commit-msg hook after the user edits the message.
   104→// If the message contains only our trailer (no actual user content), strip it
   105→// so git will abort the commit due to empty message.
   106→//
   107→//nolint:unparam // error return required by interface but hooks must return nil
   108→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CommitMsg(commitMsgFile string) error {
   109→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // Path comes from git hook
   110→	if err != nil {
   111→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   112→	}
   113→
   114→	message := string(content)
   115→
   116→	// Check if our trailer is present (ParseCheckpoint validates format, so found==true means valid)
   117→	if _, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); !found {
   118→		// No trailer, nothing to do
   119→		return nil
   120→	}
   121→
   122→	// Check if there's any user content (non-comment, non-trailer lines)
   123→	if !hasUserContent(message) {
   124→		// No user content - strip the trailer so git aborts
   125→		message = stripCheckpointTrailer(message)
   126→		if err := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); err != nil {
   127→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   128→		}
   129→	}
   130→
   131→	return nil
   132→}
   133→
   134→// hasUserContent checks if the message has any content besides comments and our trailer.
   135→func hasUserContent(message string) bool {
   136→	trailerPrefix := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ":"
   137→	for _, line := range strings.Split(message, "\n") {
   138→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
   139→		// Skip empty lines
   140→		if trimmed == "" {
   141→			continue
   142→		}
   143→		// Skip comment lines
   144→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "#") {
   145→			continue
   146→		}
   147→		// Skip our trailer line
   148→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, trailerPrefix) {
   149→			continue
   150→		}
   151→		// Found user content
   152→		return true
   153→	}
   154→	return false
   155→}
   156→
   157→// stripCheckpointTrailer removes the Entire-Checkpoint trailer line from the message.
   158→func stripCheckpointTrailer(message string) string {
   159→	trailerPrefix := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ":"
   160→	var result []string
   161→	for _, line := range strings.Split(message, "\n") {
   162→		if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line), trailerPrefix) {
   163→			result = append(result, line)
   164→		}
   165→	}
   166→	return strings.Join(result, "\n")
   167→}

   169→// isGitSequenceOperation checks if git is currently in the middle of a rebase,
   170→// cherry-pick, or revert operation. During these operations, commits are being
   171→// replayed and should not be linked to agent sessions.
   172→//
   173→// Detects:
   174→//   - rebase: .git/rebase-merge/ or .git/rebase-apply/ directories
   175→//   - cherry-pick: .git/CHERRY_PICK_HEAD file
   176→//   - revert: .git/REVERT_HEAD file
   177→func isGitSequenceOperation() bool {
   178→	// Get git directory (handles worktrees and relative paths correctly)
   179→	gitDir, err := GetGitDir()
   180→	if err != nil {
   181→		return false // Can't determine, assume not in sequence operation
   182→	}
   183→
   184→	// Check for rebase state directories
   185→	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "rebase-merge")); err == nil {
   186→		return true
   187→	}
   188→	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "rebase-apply")); err == nil {
   189→		return true
   190→	}
   191→
   192→	// Check for cherry-pick and revert state files
   193→	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "CHERRY_PICK_HEAD")); err == nil {
   194→		return true
   195→	}
   196→	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "REVERT_HEAD")); err == nil {
   197→		return true
   198→	}
   199→
   200→	return false
   201→}

   203→// PrepareCommitMsg is called by the git prepare-commit-msg hook.
   204→// Adds an Entire-Checkpoint trailer to the commit message with a stable checkpoint ID.
   205→// Only adds a trailer if there's actually new session content to condense.
   206→// The actual condensation happens in PostCommit - if the user removes the trailer,
   207→// the commit will not be linked to the session (useful for "manual" commits).
   208→// For amended commits, preserves the existing checkpoint ID.
   209→//
   210→// The source parameter indicates how the commit was initiated:
   211→//   - "" or "template": normal editor flow - adds trailer with explanatory comment
   212→//   - "message": using -m or -F flag - prompts user interactively via /dev/tty
   213→//   - "merge", "squash": skip trailer entirely (auto-generated messages)
   214→//   - "commit": amend operation - preserves existing trailer or restores from LastCheckpointID
   215→//
   216→
   217→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PrepareCommitMsg(commitMsgFile string, source string) error {
   218→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
   219→
   220→	// Skip during rebase, cherry-pick, or revert operations
   221→	// These are replaying existing commits and should not be linked to agent sessions
   222→	if isGitSequenceOperation() {
   223→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: skipped during git sequence operation",
   224→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   225→			slog.String("source", source),
   226→		)
   227→		return nil
   228→	}
   229→
   230→	// Skip for merge and squash sources
   231→	// These are auto-generated messages - not from Claude sessions
   232→	switch source {
   233→	case "merge", "squash":
   234→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: skipped for source",
   235→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   236→			slog.String("source", source),
   237→		)
   238→		return nil
   239→	}
   240→
   241→	// Handle amend (source="commit") separately: preserve or restore trailer
   242→	if source == "commit" {
   243→		return s.handleAmendCommitMsg(logCtx, commitMsgFile)
   244→	}
   245→
   246→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   247→	if err != nil {
   248→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   249→	}
   250→
   251→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   252→	if err != nil {
   253→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   254→	}
   255→
   256→	// Find all active sessions for this worktree
   257→	// We match by worktree (not BaseCommit) because the user may have made
   258→	// intermediate commits without entering new prompts, causing HEAD to diverge
   259→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   260→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   261→		// No active sessions or error listing - silently skip (hooks must be resilient)
   262→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: no active sessions",
   263→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   264→			slog.String("source", source),
   265→		)
   266→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional: hooks must be silent on failure
   267→	}
   268→
   269→	// Fast path: when an agent is committing (ACTIVE session + no TTY), skip
   270→	// content detection and interactive prompts. The agent can't respond to TTY
   271→	// prompts and the content detection can miss mid-session work (no shadow
   272→	// branch yet, transcript analysis may fail). Generate a checkpoint ID and
   273→	// add the trailer directly.
   274→	if !hasTTY() {
   275→		for _, state := range sessions {
   276→			if state.Phase.IsActive() {
   277→				return s.addTrailerForAgentCommit(logCtx, commitMsgFile, state, source)
   278→			}
   279→		}
   280→	}
   281→
   282→	// Check if any session has new content to condense
   283→	sessionsWithContent := s.filterSessionsWithNewContent(repo, sessions)
   284→
   285→	if len(sessionsWithContent) == 0 {
   286→		// No new content — no trailer needed
   287→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: no content to link",
   288→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   289→			slog.String("source", source),
   290→			slog.Int("sessions_found", len(sessions)),
   291→		)
   292→		return nil
   293→	}
   294→
   295→	// Read current commit message
   296→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // commitMsgFile is provided by git hook
   297→	if err != nil {
   298→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   299→	}
   300→
   301→	message := string(content)
   302→
   303→	// Check if trailer already exists (ParseCheckpoint validates format, so found==true means valid)
   304→	if existingCpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); found {
   305→		// Trailer already exists (e.g., amend) - keep it
   306→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: trailer already exists",
   307→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   308→			slog.String("source", source),
   309→			slog.String("existing_checkpoint_id", existingCpID.String()),
   310→		)
   311→		return nil
   312→	}
   313→
   314→	// Generate a fresh checkpoint ID
   315→	checkpointID, err := id.Generate()
   316→	if err != nil {
   317→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate checkpoint ID: %w", err)
   318→	}
   319→
   320→	// Determine agent type and last prompt from session
   321→	agentType := DefaultAgentType // default for backward compatibility
   322→	var lastPrompt string
   323→	if len(sessionsWithContent) > 0 {
   324→		firstSession := sessionsWithContent[0]
   325→		if firstSession.AgentType != "" {
   326→			agentType = firstSession.AgentType
   327→		}
   328→		lastPrompt = s.getLastPrompt(repo, firstSession)
   329→	}
   330→
   331→	// Prepare prompt for display: collapse newlines/whitespace, then truncate (rune-safe)
   332→	displayPrompt := stringutil.TruncateRunes(stringutil.CollapseWhitespace(lastPrompt), 80, "...")
   333→
   334→	// Add trailer differently based on commit source
   335→	switch source {
   336→	case "message":
   337→		// Using -m or -F: ask user interactively whether to add trailer
   338→		// (comments won't be stripped by git in this mode)
   339→
   340→		// Build context string for interactive prompt
   341→		var promptContext string
   342→		if displayPrompt != "" {
   343→			promptContext = "You have an active " + string(agentType) + " session.\nLast Prompt: " + displayPrompt
   344→		}
   345→
   346→		if !askConfirmTTY("Link this commit to "+string(agentType)+" session context?", promptContext, true) {
   347→			// User declined - don't add trailer
   348→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: user declined trailer",
   349→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   350→				slog.String("source", source),
   351→			)
   352→			return nil
   353→		}
   354→		message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, checkpointID)
   355→	default:
   356→		// Normal editor flow: add trailer with explanatory comment (will be stripped by git)
   357→		message = addCheckpointTrailerWithComment(message, checkpointID, string(agentType), displayPrompt)
   358→	}
   359→
   360→	logging.Info(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: trailer added",
   361→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   362→		slog.String("source", source),
   363→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   364→	)
   365→
   366→	// Write updated message back
   367→	if err := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); err != nil {
   368→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   369→	}
   370→
   371→	return nil
   372→}
   373→
   374→// handleAmendCommitMsg handles the prepare-commit-msg hook for amend operations
   375→// (source="commit"). It preserves existing trailers or restores from LastCheckpointID.
   376→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) handleAmendCommitMsg(logCtx context.Context, commitMsgFile string) error {
   377→	// Read current commit message
   378→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // commitMsgFile is provided by git hook
   379→	if err != nil {
   380→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   381→	}
   382→
   383→	message := string(content)
   384→
   385→	// If message already has a trailer, keep it unchanged
   386→	if existingCpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); found {
   387→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: amend preserves existing trailer",
   388→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   389→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", existingCpID.String()),
   390→		)
   391→		return nil
   392→	}
   393→
   394→	// No trailer in message — check if any session has LastCheckpointID to restore
   395→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   396→	if err != nil {
   397→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   398→	}
   399→
   400→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   401→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   402→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // No sessions - nothing to restore
   403→	}
   404→
   405→	// For amend, HEAD^ is the commit being amended, and HEAD is where we are now.
   406→	// We need to match sessions whose BaseCommit equals HEAD (the commit being amended
   407→	// was created from this base). This prevents stale sessions from injecting
   408→	// unrelated checkpoint IDs.
   409→	repo, repoErr := OpenRepository()
   410→	if repoErr != nil {
   411→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   412→	}
   413→	head, headErr := repo.Head()
   414→	if headErr != nil {
   415→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   416→	}
   417→	currentHead := head.Hash().String()
   418→
   419→	// Find first matching session with LastCheckpointID to restore.
   420→	// LastCheckpointID is set after condensation completes.
   421→	for _, state := range sessions {
   422→		if state.BaseCommit != currentHead {
   423→			continue
   424→		}
   425→		if state.LastCheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
   426→			continue
   427→		}
   428→		cpID := state.LastCheckpointID
   429→		source := "LastCheckpointID"
   430→
   431→		// Restore the trailer
   432→		message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, cpID)
   433→		if writeErr := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); writeErr != nil {
   434→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   435→		}
   436→
   437→		logging.Info(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: restored trailer on amend",
   438→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   439→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpID.String()),
   440→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   441→			slog.String("source", source),
   442→		)
   443→		return nil
   444→	}
   445→
   446→	// No checkpoint ID found - leave message unchanged
   447→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: amend with no checkpoint to restore",
   448→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   449→	)
   450→	return nil
   451→}
   452→
   453→// PostCommit is called by the git post-commit hook after a commit is created.
   454→// Uses the session state machine to determine what action to take per session:
   455→//   - ACTIVE → condense immediately (each commit gets its own checkpoint)
   456→//   - IDLE → condense immediately
   457→//   - ENDED → condense if files touched, discard if empty
   458→//
   459→// After condensation for ACTIVE sessions, remaining uncommitted files are
   460→// carried forward to a new shadow branch so the next commit gets its own checkpoint.
   461→//
   462→// Shadow branches are only deleted when ALL sessions sharing the branch are non-active
   463→// and were condensed during this PostCommit.
   464→// During rebase/cherry-pick/revert operations, phase transitions are skipped entirely.
   465→//
   466→//nolint:unparam // error return required by interface but hooks must return nil
   467→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PostCommit() error {
   468→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
   469→
   470→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   471→	if err != nil {
   472→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   473→	}
   474→
   475→	// Get HEAD commit to check for trailer
   476→	head, err := repo.Head()
   477→	if err != nil {
   478→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   479→	}
   480→
   481→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   482→	if err != nil {
   483→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   484→	}
   485→
   486→	// Check if commit has checkpoint trailer (ParseCheckpoint validates format)
   487→	checkpointID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit.Message)
   488→	if !found {
   489→		// No trailer — user removed it or it was never added (mid-turn commit).
   490→		// Still update BaseCommit for active sessions so future commits can match.
   491→		s.postCommitUpdateBaseCommitOnly(logCtx, head)
   492→		return nil
   493→	}
   494→
   495→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   496→	if err != nil {
   497→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   498→	}
   499→
   500→	// Find all active sessions for this worktree
   501→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   502→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   503→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: no active sessions despite trailer",
   504→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   505→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   506→		)
   507→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional: hooks must be silent on failure
   508→	}
   509→
   510→	// Build transition context
   511→	isRebase := isGitSequenceOperation()
   512→	transitionCtx := session.TransitionContext{
   513→		IsRebaseInProgress: isRebase,
   514→	}
   515→
   516→	if isRebase {
   517→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: rebase/sequence in progress, skipping phase transitions",
   518→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   519→		)
   520→	}
   521→
   522→	// Track shadow branch names and whether they can be deleted
   523→	shadowBranchesToDelete := make(map[string]struct{})
   524→	// Track active sessions that were NOT condensed — their shadow branches must be preserved
   525→	uncondensedActiveOnBranch := make(map[string]bool)
   526→
   527→	newHead := head.Hash().String()
   528→	committedFileSet := filesChangedInCommit(commit)
   529→
   530→	for _, state := range sessions {
   531→		shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   532→
   533→		// Check for new content (needed for TransitionContext and condensation).
   534→		// Fail-open: if content check errors, assume new content exists so we
   535→		// don't silently skip data that should have been condensed.
   536→		//
   537→		// For ACTIVE sessions: the commit has a checkpoint trailer (verified above),
   538→		// meaning PrepareCommitMsg already determined this commit is session-related.
   539→		// We trust that and assume hasNew = true, bypassing sessionHasNewContent which
   540→		// would incorrectly return false (uses getStagedFiles, but files are no longer
   541→		// staged after the commit).
   542→		var hasNew bool
   543→		if state.Phase.IsActive() {
   544→			// PrepareCommitMsg added the trailer → commit is session-related
   545→			hasNew = true
   546→		} else {
   547→			var contentErr error
   548→			hasNew, contentErr = s.sessionHasNewContent(repo, state)
   549→			if contentErr != nil {
   550→				hasNew = true
   551→				logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: error checking session content, assuming new content",
   552→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   553→					slog.String("error", contentErr.Error()),
   554→				)
   555→			}
   556→		}
   557→		transitionCtx.HasFilesTouched = len(state.FilesTouched) > 0
   558→
   559→		// Run the state machine transition
   560→		remaining := TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventGitCommit, transitionCtx)
   561→
   562→		// Save FilesTouched BEFORE the action loop — condensation clears it,
   563→		// but we need the original list for carry-forward computation.
   564→		// For mid-session commits (ACTIVE, no shadow branch), state.FilesTouched may be empty
   565→		// because no SaveChanges/Stop has been called yet. Extract files from transcript.
   566→		filesTouchedBefore := make([]string, len(state.FilesTouched))
   567→		copy(filesTouchedBefore, state.FilesTouched)
   568→		if len(filesTouchedBefore) == 0 && state.Phase.IsActive() && state.TranscriptPath != "" {
   569→			filesTouchedBefore = s.extractFilesFromLiveTranscript(state)
   570→		}
   571→
   572→		condensed := false
   573→
   574→		// Dispatch strategy-specific actions.
   575→		// Each branch handles its own BaseCommit update so there is no
   576→		// fallthrough conditional at the end. On condensation failure,
   577→		// BaseCommit is intentionally NOT updated to preserve access to
   578→		// the shadow branch (which is named after the old BaseCommit).
   579→		for _, action := range remaining {
   580→			switch action {
   581→			case session.ActionCondense:
   582→				// For ACTIVE sessions, any commit during the turn is session-related.
   583→				// For IDLE/ENDED sessions (e.g., carry-forward), also require that the
   584→				// committed files overlap with the session's remaining files — otherwise
   585→				// an unrelated commit would incorrectly get this session's checkpoint.
   586→				shouldCondense := hasNew
   587→				if shouldCondense && !state.Phase.IsActive() {
   588→					shouldCondense = filesOverlap(committedFileSet, state.FilesTouched)
   589→				}
   590→				if shouldCondense {
   591→					condensed = s.condenseAndUpdateState(logCtx, repo, checkpointID, state, head, shadowBranchName, shadowBranchesToDelete)
   592→					// condenseAndUpdateState updates BaseCommit on success.
   593→					// On failure, BaseCommit is preserved so the shadow branch remains accessible.
   594→				} else {
   595→					// No new content or unrelated commit — just update BaseCommit
   596→					s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   597→				}
   598→			case session.ActionCondenseIfFilesTouched:
   599→				// The state machine already gates this action on HasFilesTouched,
   600→				// but hasNew is an additional content-level check (transcript has
   601→				// new content beyond what was previously condensed).
   602→				if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 && hasNew {
   603→					condensed = s.condenseAndUpdateState(logCtx, repo, checkpointID, state, head, shadowBranchName, shadowBranchesToDelete)
   604→					// On failure, BaseCommit is preserved (same as ActionCondense).
   605→				} else {
   606→					s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   607→				}
   608→			case session.ActionDiscardIfNoFiles:
   609→				if len(state.FilesTouched) == 0 {
   610→					logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: skipping empty ended session (no files to condense)",
   611→						slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   612→					)
   613→				}
   614→				s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   615→			case session.ActionClearEndedAt, session.ActionUpdateLastInteraction:
   616→				// Handled by session.ApplyCommonActions above
   617→			case session.ActionWarnStaleSession:
   618→				// Not produced by EventGitCommit; listed for switch exhaustiveness
   619→			}
   620→		}
   621→
   622→		// Record checkpoint ID for ACTIVE sessions so HandleTurnEnd can finalize
   623→		// with full transcript. IDLE/ENDED sessions already have complete transcripts.
   624→		if condensed && state.Phase.IsActive() {
   625→			state.TurnCheckpointIDs = append(state.TurnCheckpointIDs, checkpointID.String())
   626→		}
   627→
   628→		// Carry forward remaining uncommitted files so the next commit gets its
   629→		// own checkpoint ID. This applies to ALL phases — if a user splits their
   630→		// commit across two `git commit` invocations, each gets a 1:1 checkpoint.
   631→		if condensed {
   632→			remainingFiles := subtractFiles(filesTouchedBefore, committedFileSet)
   633→			if len(remainingFiles) > 0 {
   634→				s.carryForwardToNewShadowBranch(logCtx, repo, state, remainingFiles)
   635→			}
   636→		}
   637→
   638→		// Save the updated state
   639→		if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   640→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", err)
   641→		}
   642→
   643→		// Only preserve shadow branch for active sessions that were NOT condensed.
   644→		// Condensed sessions already have their data on entire/checkpoints/v1.
   645→		if state.Phase.IsActive() && !condensed {
   646→			uncondensedActiveOnBranch[shadowBranchName] = true
   647→		}
   648→	}
   649→
   650→	// Clean up shadow branches — only delete when ALL sessions on the branch are non-active
   651→	// or were condensed during this PostCommit.
   652→	for shadowBranchName := range shadowBranchesToDelete {
   653→		if uncondensedActiveOnBranch[shadowBranchName] {
   654→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: preserving shadow branch (active session exists)",
   655→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   656→			)
   657→			continue
   658→		}
   659→		if err := deleteShadowBranch(repo, shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   660→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to clean up %s: %v\n", shadowBranchName, err)
   661→		} else {
   662→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Cleaned up shadow branch: %s\n", shadowBranchName)
   663→			logging.Info(logCtx, "shadow branch deleted",
   664→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   665→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   666→			)
   667→		}
   668→	}
   669→
   670→	return nil
   671→}
   672→
   673→// condenseAndUpdateState runs condensation for a session and updates state afterward.
   674→// Returns true if condensation succeeded.
   675→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) condenseAndUpdateState(
   676→	logCtx context.Context,
   677→	repo *git.Repository,
   678→	checkpointID id.CheckpointID,
   679→	state *SessionState,
   680→	head *plumbing.Reference,
   681→	shadowBranchName string,
   682→	shadowBranchesToDelete map[string]struct{},
   683→) bool {
   684→	result, err := s.CondenseSession(repo, checkpointID, state)
   685→	if err != nil {
   686→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: condensation failed for session %s: %v\n",
   687→			state.SessionID, err)
   688→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: condensation failed",
   689→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   690→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   691→		)
   692→		return false
   693→	}
   694→
   695→	// Track this shadow branch for cleanup
   696→	shadowBranchesToDelete[shadowBranchName] = struct{}{}
   697→
   698→	// Update session state for the new base commit
   699→	newHead := head.Hash().String()
   700→	state.BaseCommit = newHead
   701→	state.AttributionBaseCommit = newHead
   702→	state.StepCount = 0
   703→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   704→
   705→	// Clear attribution tracking — condensation already used these values
   706→	state.PromptAttributions = nil
   707→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
   708→	state.FilesTouched = nil
   709→
   710→	// Save checkpoint ID so subsequent commits can reuse it (e.g., amend restores trailer)
   711→	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   712→
   713→	shortID := state.SessionID
   714→	if len(shortID) > 8 {
   715→		shortID = shortID[:8]
   716→	}
   717→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Condensed session %s: %s (%d checkpoints)\n",
   718→		shortID, result.CheckpointID, result.CheckpointsCount)
   719→
   720→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session condensed",
   721→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   722→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   723→		slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
   724→		slog.Int("transcript_lines", result.TotalTranscriptLines),
   725→	)
   726→
   727→	return true
   728→}

   730→// updateBaseCommitIfChanged updates BaseCommit to newHead if it changed.
   731→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx context.Context, state *SessionState, newHead string) {
   732→	if state.BaseCommit != newHead {
   733→		state.BaseCommit = newHead
   734→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: updated BaseCommit",
   735→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   736→			slog.String("new_head", truncateHash(newHead)),
   737→		)
   738→	}
   739→}
   740→
   741→// postCommitUpdateBaseCommitOnly updates BaseCommit for all sessions on the current
   742→// worktree when a commit has no Entire-Checkpoint trailer. This prevents BaseCommit
   743→// from going stale, which would cause future PrepareCommitMsg calls to skip the
   744→// session (BaseCommit != currentHeadHash filter).
   745→//
   746→// Unlike the full PostCommit flow, this does NOT fire EventGitCommit or trigger
   747→// condensation — it only keeps BaseCommit in sync with HEAD.
   748→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) postCommitUpdateBaseCommitOnly(logCtx context.Context, head *plumbing.Reference) {
   749→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   750→	if err != nil {
   751→		return // Silent failure — hooks must be resilient
   752→	}
   753→
   754→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   755→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   756→		return
   757→	}
   758→
   759→	newHead := head.Hash().String()
   760→	for _, state := range sessions {
   761→		// Only update active sessions. Idle/ended sessions are kept around for
   762→		// LastCheckpointID reuse and should not be advanced to HEAD.
   763→		if !state.Phase.IsActive() {
   764→			continue
   765→		}
   766→		if state.BaseCommit != newHead {
   767→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit (no trailer): updating BaseCommit",
   768→				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   769→				slog.String("old_base", truncateHash(state.BaseCommit)),
   770→				slog.String("new_head", truncateHash(newHead)),
   771→			)
   772→			state.BaseCommit = newHead
   773→			if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   774→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", err)
   775→			}
   776→		}
   777→	}
   778→}
   779→
   780→// truncateHash safely truncates a git hash to 7 chars for logging.
   781→func truncateHash(h string) string {
   782→	if len(h) > 7 {
   783→		return h[:7]
   784→	}
   785→	return h
   786→}
   787→
   788→// filterSessionsWithNewContent returns sessions that have new transcript content
   789→// beyond what was already condensed.
   790→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) filterSessionsWithNewContent(repo *git.Repository, sessions []*SessionState) []*SessionState {
   791→	var result []*SessionState
   792→
   793→	for _, state := range sessions {
   794→		hasNew, err := s.sessionHasNewContent(repo, state)
   795→		if err != nil {
   796→			// On error, include the session (fail open for hooks)
   797→			result = append(result, state)
   798→			continue
   799→		}
   800→		if hasNew {
   801→			result = append(result, state)
   802→		}
   803→	}
   804→
   805→	return result
   806→}
   807→
   808→// sessionHasNewContent checks if a session has new transcript content
   809→// beyond what was already condensed.
   810→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) sessionHasNewContent(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, error) {
   811→	// Get shadow branch
   812→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   813→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   814→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   815→	if err != nil {
   816→		// No shadow branch means no Stop has happened since the last condensation.
   817→		// However, the agent may have done work (including commits) without a Stop.
   818→		// Check the live transcript to detect this scenario.
   819→		return s.sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript(repo, state)
   820→	}
   821→
   822→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   823→	if err != nil {
   824→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   825→	}
   826→
   827→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   828→	if err != nil {
   829→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   830→	}
   831→
   832→	// Look for transcript file
   833→	metadataDir := paths.EntireMetadataDir + "/" + state.SessionID
   834→	var transcriptLines int
   835→
   836→	if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   837→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   838→			transcriptLines = countTranscriptItems(state.AgentType, content)
   839→		}
   840→	} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   841→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   842→			transcriptLines = countTranscriptItems(state.AgentType, content)
   843→		}
   844→	}
   845→
   846→	// Has new content if there are more lines than already condensed
   847→	return transcriptLines > state.CheckpointTranscriptStart, nil
   848→}
   849→
   850→// sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript checks if a session has new content
   851→// by examining the live transcript file. This is used when no shadow branch exists
   852→// (i.e., no Stop has happened yet) but the agent may have done work.
   853→//
   854→// Returns true if:
   855→//  1. The transcript has grown since the last condensation, AND
   856→//  2. The new transcript portion contains file modifications, AND
   857→//  3. At least one modified file overlaps with the currently staged files
   858→//
   859→// The overlap check ensures we don't add checkpoint trailers to commits that are
   860→// unrelated to the agent's recent changes.
   861→//
   862→// This handles the scenario where the agent commits mid-session before Stop.
   863→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, error) {
   864→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
   865→
   866→	// Need both transcript path and agent type to analyze
   867→	if state.TranscriptPath == "" || state.AgentType == "" {
   868→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "live transcript check: missing transcript path or agent type",
   869→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   870→			slog.String("transcript_path", state.TranscriptPath),
   871→			slog.String("agent_type", string(state.AgentType)),
   872→		)
   873→		return false, nil
   874→	}
   875→
   876→	// Get the agent for transcript analysis
   877→	ag, err := agent.GetByAgentType(state.AgentType)
   878→	if err != nil {
   879→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Unknown agent type, fail gracefully
   880→	}
   881→
   882→	// Cast to TranscriptAnalyzer
   883→	analyzer, ok := ag.(agent.TranscriptAnalyzer)
   884→	if !ok {
   885→		return false, nil // Agent doesn't support transcript analysis
   886→	}
   887→
   888→	// Get current transcript position
   889→	currentPos, err := analyzer.GetTranscriptPosition(state.TranscriptPath)
   890→	if err != nil {
   891→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Error reading transcript, fail gracefully
   892→	}
   893→
   894→	// Check if transcript has grown since last condensation
   895→	if currentPos <= state.CheckpointTranscriptStart {
   896→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "live transcript check: no new content",
   897→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   898→			slog.Int("current_pos", currentPos),
   899→			slog.Int("start_offset", state.CheckpointTranscriptStart),
   900→		)
   901→		return false, nil // No new content
   902→	}
   903→
   904→	// Transcript has grown - check if there are file modifications in the new portion
   905→	modifiedFiles, _, err := analyzer.ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(state.TranscriptPath, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   906→	if err != nil {
   907→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Error parsing transcript, fail gracefully
   908→	}
   909→
   910→	// No file modifications means no new content to checkpoint
   911→	if len(modifiedFiles) == 0 {
   912→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "live transcript check: transcript grew but no file modifications",
   913→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   914→		)
   915→		return false, nil
   916→	}
   917→
   918→	// Normalize modified files from absolute to repo-relative paths.
   919→	// Transcript tool_use entries contain absolute paths (e.g., /Users/alex/project/src/main.go)
   920→	// but getStagedFiles returns repo-relative paths (e.g., src/main.go).
   921→	// Use state.WorktreePath (already resolved) to avoid an extra git subprocess.
   922→	basePath := state.WorktreePath
   923→	if basePath == "" {
   924→		if wp, wpErr := GetWorktreePath(); wpErr == nil {
   925→			basePath = wp
   926→		}
   927→	}
   928→	if basePath != "" {
   929→		normalized := make([]string, 0, len(modifiedFiles))
   930→		for _, f := range modifiedFiles {
   931→			if rel := paths.ToRelativePath(f, basePath); rel != "" {
   932→				normalized = append(normalized, rel)
   933→			} else {
   934→				// Already relative or outside repo — keep as-is
   935→				normalized = append(normalized, f)
   936→			}
   937→		}
   938→		modifiedFiles = normalized
   939→	}
   940→
   941→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "live transcript check: found file modifications",
   942→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   943→		slog.Int("modified_files", len(modifiedFiles)),
   944→	)
   945→
   946→	// Check if any modified files overlap with currently staged files
   947→	// This ensures we only add checkpoint trailers to commits that include
   948→	// files the agent actually modified
   949→	stagedFiles := getStagedFiles(repo)
   950→
   951→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "live transcript check: comparing staged vs modified",
   952→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   953→		slog.Int("staged_files", len(stagedFiles)),
   954→		slog.Int("modified_files", len(modifiedFiles)),
   955→	)
   956→
   957→	if !hasOverlappingFiles(stagedFiles, modifiedFiles) {
   958→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "live transcript check: no overlap between staged and modified files",
   959→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   960→		)
   961→		return false, nil // No overlap - staged files are unrelated to agent's work
   962→	}
   963→
   964→	return true, nil
   965→}
   966→
   967→// extractFilesFromLiveTranscript extracts modified file paths from the live transcript.
   968→// Returns empty slice if extraction fails (fail-open behavior for hooks).
   969→// Extracts ALL files from the transcript (offset 0) because this is used for carry-forward
   970→// computation which needs to know all files touched, not just new ones.
   971→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) extractFilesFromLiveTranscript(state *SessionState) []string {
   972→	if state.TranscriptPath == "" || state.AgentType == "" {
   973→		return nil
   974→	}
   975→
   976→	ag, err := agent.GetByAgentType(state.AgentType)
   977→	if err != nil {
   978→		return nil
   979→	}
   980→
   981→	analyzer, ok := ag.(agent.TranscriptAnalyzer)
   982→	if !ok {
   983→		return nil
   984→	}
   985→
   986→	// Extract ALL files from transcript (offset 0) for carry-forward computation.
   987→	// state.CheckpointTranscriptStart may already be updated after condensation,
   988→	// but carry-forward needs to know all files touched to compute remaining files.
   989→	modifiedFiles, _, err := analyzer.ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(state.TranscriptPath, 0)
   990→	if err != nil || len(modifiedFiles) == 0 {
   991→		return nil
   992→	}
   993→
   994→	// Normalize to repo-relative paths
   995→	basePath := state.WorktreePath
   996→	if basePath == "" {
   997→		if wp, wpErr := GetWorktreePath(); wpErr == nil {
   998→			basePath = wp
   999→		}
  1000→	}
  1001→	if basePath != "" {
  1002→		normalized := make([]string, 0, len(modifiedFiles))
  1003→		for _, f := range modifiedFiles {
  1004→			if rel := paths.ToRelativePath(f, basePath); rel != "" {
  1005→				normalized = append(normalized, rel)
  1006→			} else {
  1007→				normalized = append(normalized, f)
  1008→			}
  1009→		}
  1010→		modifiedFiles = normalized
  1011→	}
  1012→
  1013→	return modifiedFiles
  1014→}

  1016→// addTrailerForAgentCommit handles the fast path when an agent is committing
  1017→// (ACTIVE session + no TTY). Generates a checkpoint ID and adds the trailer
  1018→// directly, bypassing content detection and interactive prompts.
  1019→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) addTrailerForAgentCommit(logCtx context.Context, commitMsgFile string, state *SessionState, source string) error {
  1020→	cpID, err := id.Generate()
  1021→	if err != nil {
  1022→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
  1023→	}
  1024→
  1025→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // commitMsgFile is provided by git hook
  1026→	if err != nil {
  1027→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
  1028→	}
  1029→
  1030→	message := string(content)
  1031→
  1032→	// Don't add if trailer already exists
  1033→	if _, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); found {
  1034→		return nil
  1035→	}
  1036→
  1037→	message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, cpID)
  1038→
  1039→	logging.Info(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: agent commit trailer added",
  1040→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
  1041→		slog.String("source", source),
  1042→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpID.String()),
  1043→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1044→	)
  1045→
  1046→	if err := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); err != nil {
  1047→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
  1048→	}
  1049→	return nil
  1050→}
  1051→
  1052→// addCheckpointTrailer adds the Entire-Checkpoint trailer to a commit message.
  1053→// Handles proper trailer formatting (blank line before trailers if needed).
  1054→func addCheckpointTrailer(message string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) string {
  1055→	trailer := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ": " + checkpointID.String()
  1056→
  1057→	// If message already ends with trailers (lines starting with key:), just append
  1058→	// Otherwise, add a blank line first
  1059→	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(message, "\n"), "\n")
  1060→
  1061→	// Check if last non-empty, non-comment line looks like a trailer
  1062→	// Git comment lines start with # and may contain ": " (e.g., "# Changes to be committed:")
  1063→	hasTrailers := false
  1064→	for i := len(lines) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
  1065→		line := strings.TrimSpace(lines[i])
  1066→		if line == "" {
  1067→			break
  1068→		}
  1069→		// Skip git comment lines
  1070→		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
  1071→			continue
  1072→		}
  1073→		if strings.Contains(line, ": ") {
  1074→			hasTrailers = true
  1075→			break
  1076→		}
  1077→		// Non-comment, non-trailer line found - no existing trailers
  1078→		break
  1079→	}
  1080→
  1081→	if hasTrailers {
  1082→		// Append trailer directly
  1083→		return strings.TrimRight(message, "\n") + "\n" + trailer + "\n"
  1084→	}
  1085→
  1086→	// Add blank line before trailer
  1087→	return strings.TrimRight(message, "\n") + "\n\n" + trailer + "\n"
  1088→}
  1089→
  1090→// addCheckpointTrailerWithComment adds the Entire-Checkpoint trailer with an explanatory comment.
  1091→// The trailer is placed above the git comment block but below the user's message area,
  1092→// with a comment explaining that the user can remove it if they don't want to link the commit
  1093→// to the agent session. If prompt is non-empty, it's shown as context.
  1094→func addCheckpointTrailerWithComment(message string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, agentName, prompt string) string {
  1095→	trailer := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ": " + checkpointID.String()
  1096→	commentLines := []string{
  1097→		"# Remove the Entire-Checkpoint trailer above if you don't want to link this commit to " + agentName + " session context.",
  1098→	}
  1099→	if prompt != "" {
  1100→		commentLines = append(commentLines, "# Last Prompt: "+prompt)
  1101→	}
  1102→	commentLines = append(commentLines, "# The trailer will be added to your next commit based on this branch.")
  1103→	comment := strings.Join(commentLines, "\n")
  1104→
  1105→	lines := strings.Split(message, "\n")
  1106→
  1107→	// Find where the git comment block starts (first # line)
  1108→	commentStart := -1
  1109→	for i, line := range lines {
  1110→		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
  1111→			commentStart = i
  1112→			break
  1113→		}
  1114→	}
  1115→
  1116→	if commentStart == -1 {
  1117→		// No git comments, append trailer at the end
  1118→		return strings.TrimRight(message, "\n") + "\n\n" + trailer + "\n" + comment + "\n"
  1119→	}
  1120→
  1121→	// Split into user content and git comments
  1122→	userContent := strings.Join(lines[:commentStart], "\n")
  1123→	gitComments := strings.Join(lines[commentStart:], "\n")
  1124→
  1125→	// Build result: user content, blank line, trailer, comment, blank line, git comments
  1126→	userContent = strings.TrimRight(userContent, "\n")
  1127→	if userContent == "" {
  1128→		// No user content yet - leave space for them to type, then trailer
  1129→		// Two newlines: first for user's message line, second for blank separator
  1130→		return "\n\n" + trailer + "\n" + comment + "\n\n" + gitComments
  1131→	}
  1132→	return userContent + "\n\n" + trailer + "\n" + comment + "\n\n" + gitComments
  1133→}

  1135→// InitializeSession creates session state for a new session or updates an existing one.
  1136→// This implements the optional SessionInitializer interface.
  1137→// Called during UserPromptSubmit to allow git hooks to detect active sessions.
  1138→//
  1139→// If the session already exists and HEAD has moved (e.g., user committed), updates
  1140→// BaseCommit to the new HEAD so future checkpoints go to the correct shadow branch.
  1141→//
  1142→// If there's an existing shadow branch with commits from a different session ID,
  1143→// returns a SessionIDConflictError to prevent orphaning existing session work.
  1144→//
  1145→// agentType is the human-readable name of the agent (e.g., "Claude Code").
  1146→// transcriptPath is the path to the live transcript file (for mid-session commit detection).
  1147→// userPrompt is the user's prompt text (stored truncated as FirstPrompt for display).
  1148→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) InitializeSession(sessionID string, agentType agent.AgentType, transcriptPath string, userPrompt string) error {
  1149→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
  1150→	if err != nil {
  1151→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open git repository: %w", err)
  1152→	}
  1153→
  1154→	// Check if session already exists
  1155→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
  1156→	if err != nil {
  1157→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to check session state: %w", err)
  1158→	}
  1159→
  1160→	if state != nil && state.BaseCommit != "" {
  1161→		// Session is fully initialized — apply phase transition for TurnStart
  1162→		TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventTurnStart, session.TransitionContext{})
  1163→
  1164→		// Generate a new TurnID for each turn (correlates carry-forward checkpoints)
  1165→		turnID, err := id.Generate()
  1166→		if err != nil {
  1167→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate turn ID: %w", err)
  1168→		}
  1169→		state.TurnID = turnID.String()
  1170→
  1171→		// Backfill AgentType if empty or set to the generic default "Agent"
  1172→		if !isSpecificAgentType(state.AgentType) && agentType != "" {
  1173→			state.AgentType = agentType
  1174→		}
  1175→
  1176→		// Backfill FirstPrompt if empty (for sessions created before the first_prompt field was added)
  1177→		if state.FirstPrompt == "" && userPrompt != "" {
  1178→			state.FirstPrompt = truncatePromptForStorage(userPrompt)
  1179→		}
  1180→
  1181→		// Update transcript path if provided (may change on session resume)
  1182→		if transcriptPath != "" && state.TranscriptPath != transcriptPath {
  1183→			state.TranscriptPath = transcriptPath
  1184→		}
  1185→
  1186→		// Clear checkpoint IDs on every new prompt.
  1187→		// LastCheckpointID is set during PostCommit, cleared at new prompt.
  1188→		// TurnCheckpointIDs tracks mid-turn checkpoints for stop-time finalization.
  1189→		state.LastCheckpointID = ""
  1190→		state.TurnCheckpointIDs = nil
  1191→
  1192→		// Calculate attribution at prompt start (BEFORE agent makes any changes)
  1193→		// This captures user edits since the last checkpoint (or base commit for first prompt).
  1194→		// IMPORTANT: Always calculate attribution, even for the first checkpoint, to capture
  1195→		// user edits made before the first prompt. The inner CalculatePromptAttribution handles
  1196→		// nil lastCheckpointTree by falling back to baseTree.
  1197→		promptAttr := s.calculatePromptAttributionAtStart(repo, state)
  1198→		state.PendingPromptAttribution = &promptAttr
  1199→
  1200→		// Check if HEAD has moved (user pulled/rebased or committed)
  1201→		// migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded handles renaming the shadow branch and updating state.BaseCommit
  1202→		if _, err := s.migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded(repo, state); err != nil {
  1203→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to check/migrate shadow branch: %w", err)
  1204→		}
  1205→
  1206→		if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
  1207→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update session state: %w", err)
  1208→		}
  1209→		return nil
  1210→	}
  1211→	// If state exists but BaseCommit is empty, it's a partial state from concurrent warning
  1212→	// Continue below to properly initialize it
  1213→
  1214→	// Initialize new session
  1215→	state, err = s.initializeSession(repo, sessionID, agentType, transcriptPath, userPrompt)
  1216→	if err != nil {
  1217→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to initialize session: %w", err)
  1218→	}
  1219→
  1220→	// Apply phase transition: new session starts as ACTIVE
  1221→	TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventTurnStart, session.TransitionContext{})
  1222→
  1223→	// Calculate attribution for pre-prompt edits
  1224→	// This captures any user edits made before the first prompt
  1225→	promptAttr := s.calculatePromptAttributionAtStart(repo, state)
  1226→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = &promptAttr
  1227→	if err = s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
  1228→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save attribution: %w", err)
  1229→	}
  1230→
  1231→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Initialized shadow session: %s\n", sessionID)
  1232→	return nil
  1233→}
  1234→
  1235→// calculatePromptAttributionAtStart calculates attribution at prompt start (before agent runs).
  1236→// This captures user changes since the last checkpoint - no filtering needed since
  1237→// the agent hasn't made any changes yet.
  1238→//
  1239→// IMPORTANT: This reads from the worktree (not staging area) to match what WriteTemporary
  1240→// captures in checkpoints. If we read staged content but checkpoints capture worktree content,
  1241→// unstaged changes would be in the checkpoint but not counted in PromptAttribution, causing
  1242→// them to be incorrectly attributed to the agent later.
  1243→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) calculatePromptAttributionAtStart(
  1244→	repo *git.Repository,
  1245→	state *SessionState,
  1246→) PromptAttribution {
  1247→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "attribution")
  1248→	nextCheckpointNum := state.StepCount + 1
  1249→	result := PromptAttribution{CheckpointNumber: nextCheckpointNum}
  1250→
  1251→	// Get last checkpoint tree from shadow branch (if it exists)
  1252→	// For the first checkpoint, no shadow branch exists yet - this is fine,
  1253→	// CalculatePromptAttribution will use baseTree as the reference instead.
  1254→	var lastCheckpointTree *object.Tree
  1255→	shadowBranchName := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
  1256→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
  1257→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
  1258→	if err != nil {
  1259→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution: no shadow branch yet (first checkpoint)",
  1260→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName))
  1261→		// Continue with lastCheckpointTree = nil
  1262→	} else {
  1263→		shadowCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
  1264→		if err != nil {
  1265→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution: failed to get shadow commit",
  1266→				slog.String("shadow_ref", ref.Hash().String()),
  1267→				slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1268→			// Continue with lastCheckpointTree = nil
  1269→		} else {
  1270→			lastCheckpointTree, err = shadowCommit.Tree()
  1271→			if err != nil {
  1272→				logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution: failed to get shadow tree",
  1273→					slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1274→				// Continue with lastCheckpointTree = nil
  1275→			}
  1276→		}
  1277→	}
  1278→
  1279→	// Get base tree for agent lines calculation
  1280→	var baseTree *object.Tree
  1281→	if baseCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(plumbing.NewHash(state.BaseCommit)); err == nil {
  1282→		if tree, treeErr := baseCommit.Tree(); treeErr == nil {
  1283→			baseTree = tree
  1284→		} else {
  1285→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution: base tree unavailable",
  1286→				slog.String("error", treeErr.Error()))
  1287→		}
  1288→	} else {
  1289→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution: base commit unavailable",
  1290→			slog.String("base_commit", state.BaseCommit),
  1291→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1292→	}
  1293→
  1294→	worktree, err := repo.Worktree()
  1295→	if err != nil {
  1296→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution skipped: failed to get worktree",
  1297→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1298→		return result
  1299→	}
  1300→
  1301→	// Get worktree status to find ALL changed files
  1302→	status, err := worktree.Status()
  1303→	if err != nil {
  1304→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution skipped: failed to get worktree status",
  1305→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
  1306→		return result
  1307→	}
  1308→
  1309→	worktreeRoot := worktree.Filesystem.Root()
  1310→
  1311→	// Build map of changed files with their worktree content
  1312→	// IMPORTANT: We read from worktree (not staging area) to match what WriteTemporary
  1313→	// captures in checkpoints. This ensures attribution is consistent.
  1314→	changedFiles := make(map[string]string)
  1315→	for filePath, fileStatus := range status {
  1316→		// Skip unmodified files
  1317→		if fileStatus.Worktree == git.Unmodified && fileStatus.Staging == git.Unmodified {
  1318→			continue
  1319→		}
  1320→		// Skip .entire metadata directory (session data, not user code)
  1321→		if strings.HasPrefix(filePath, paths.EntireMetadataDir+"/") || strings.HasPrefix(filePath, ".entire/") {
  1322→			continue
  1323→		}
  1324→
  1325→		// Always read from worktree to match checkpoint behavior
  1326→		fullPath := filepath.Join(worktreeRoot, filePath)
  1327→		var content string
  1328→		if data, err := os.ReadFile(fullPath); err == nil { //nolint:gosec // filePath is from git worktree status
  1329→			// Use git's binary detection algorithm (matches getFileContent behavior).
  1330→			// Binary files are excluded from line-based attribution calculations.
  1331→			isBinary, binErr := binary.IsBinary(bytes.NewReader(data))
  1332→			if binErr == nil && !isBinary {
  1333→				content = string(data)
  1334→			}
  1335→		}
  1336→		// else: file deleted, unreadable, or binary - content remains empty string
  1337→
  1338→		changedFiles[filePath] = content
  1339→	}
  1340→
  1341→	// Use CalculatePromptAttribution from manual_commit_attribution.go
  1342→	result = CalculatePromptAttribution(baseTree, lastCheckpointTree, changedFiles, nextCheckpointNum)
  1343→
  1344→	return result
  1345→}

  1347→// getStagedFiles returns a list of files staged for commit.
  1348→func getStagedFiles(repo *git.Repository) []string {
  1349→	worktree, err := repo.Worktree()
  1350→	if err != nil {
  1351→		return nil
  1352→	}
  1353→
  1354→	status, err := worktree.Status()
  1355→	if err != nil {
  1356→		return nil
  1357→	}
  1358→
  1359→	var staged []string
  1360→	for path, fileStatus := range status {
  1361→		// Check if file is staged (in index)
  1362→		if fileStatus.Staging != git.Unmodified && fileStatus.Staging != git.Untracked {
  1363→			staged = append(staged, path)
  1364→		}
  1365→	}
  1366→	return staged
  1367→}

  1391→// HandleTurnEnd dispatches strategy-specific actions emitted when an agent turn ends.
  1392→// The primary job is to finalize all checkpoints from this turn with the full transcript.
  1393→//
  1394→// During a turn, PostCommit writes provisional transcript data (whatever was available
  1395→// at commit time). HandleTurnEnd replaces that with the complete session transcript
  1396→// (from prompt to stop event), ensuring every checkpoint has the full context.
  1397→//
  1398→//nolint:unparam // error return required by interface but hooks must return nil
  1399→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) HandleTurnEnd(state *SessionState) error {
  1400→	// Finalize all checkpoints from this turn with the full transcript.
  1401→	// Best-effort: log warnings but don't fail the hook.
  1402→	s.finalizeAllTurnCheckpoints(state)
  1403→	return nil
  1404→}
  1405→
  1406→// finalizeAllTurnCheckpoints replaces the provisional transcript in each checkpoint
  1407→// created during this turn with the full session transcript.
  1408→//
  1409→// This is called at turn end (stop hook). During the turn, PostCommit wrote whatever
  1410→// transcript was available at commit time. Now we have the complete transcript and
  1411→// replace it so every checkpoint has the full prompt-to-stop context.
  1412→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) finalizeAllTurnCheckpoints(state *SessionState) {
  1413→	if len(state.TurnCheckpointIDs) == 0 {
  1414→		return // No mid-turn commits to finalize
  1415→	}
  1416→
  1417→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
  1418→
  1419→	logging.Info(logCtx, "finalizing turn checkpoints with full transcript",
  1420→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1421→		slog.Int("checkpoint_count", len(state.TurnCheckpointIDs)),
  1422→	)
  1423→
  1424→	// Read full transcript from live transcript file
  1425→	if state.TranscriptPath == "" {
  1426→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: no transcript path, skipping",
  1427→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1428→		)
  1429→		state.TurnCheckpointIDs = nil
  1430→		return
  1431→	}
  1432→
  1433→	fullTranscript, err := os.ReadFile(state.TranscriptPath)
  1434→	if err != nil || len(fullTranscript) == 0 {
  1435→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: failed to read transcript, skipping",
  1436→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1437→			slog.String("transcript_path", state.TranscriptPath),
  1438→		)
  1439→		state.TurnCheckpointIDs = nil
  1440→		return
  1441→	}
  1442→
  1443→	// Extract prompts and context from the full transcript
  1444→	prompts := extractUserPrompts(state.AgentType, string(fullTranscript))
  1445→	contextBytes := generateContextFromPrompts(prompts)
  1446→
  1447→	// Redact secrets before writing — matches WriteCommitted behavior.
  1448→	// The live transcript on disk contains raw content; redaction must happen
  1449→	// before anything is persisted to the metadata branch.
  1450→	fullTranscript, err = redact.JSONLBytes(fullTranscript)
  1451→	if err != nil {
  1452→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: transcript redaction failed, skipping",
  1453→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1454→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1455→		)
  1456→		state.TurnCheckpointIDs = nil
  1457→		return
  1458→	}
  1459→	for i, p := range prompts {
  1460→		prompts[i] = redact.String(p)
  1461→	}
  1462→	contextBytes = redact.Bytes(contextBytes)
  1463→
  1464→	// Open repository and create checkpoint store
  1465→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
  1466→	if err != nil {
  1467→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: failed to open repository",
  1468→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1469→		)
  1470→		state.TurnCheckpointIDs = nil
  1471→		return
  1472→	}
  1473→	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
  1474→
  1475→	// Update each checkpoint with the full transcript
  1476→	for _, cpIDStr := range state.TurnCheckpointIDs {
  1477→		cpID, parseErr := id.NewCheckpointID(cpIDStr)
  1478→		if parseErr != nil {
  1479→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: invalid checkpoint ID, skipping",
  1480→				slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpIDStr),
  1481→				slog.String("error", parseErr.Error()),
  1482→			)
  1483→			continue
  1484→		}
  1485→
  1486→		updateErr := store.UpdateCommitted(context.Background(), checkpoint.UpdateCommittedOptions{
  1487→			CheckpointID: cpID,
  1488→			SessionID:    state.SessionID,
  1489→			Transcript:   fullTranscript,
  1490→			Prompts:      prompts,
  1491→			Context:      contextBytes,
  1492→			Agent:        state.AgentType,
  1493→		})
  1494→		if updateErr != nil {
  1495→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: failed to update checkpoint",
  1496→				slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpIDStr),
  1497→				slog.String("error", updateErr.Error()),
  1498→			)
  1499→			continue
  1500→		}
  1501→
  1502→		logging.Info(logCtx, "finalize: checkpoint updated with full transcript",
  1503→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpIDStr),
  1504→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1505→		)
  1506→	}
  1507→
  1508→	// Update transcript start and clear turn checkpoint IDs
  1509→	fullTranscriptLines := countTranscriptItems(state.AgentType, string(fullTranscript))
  1510→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = fullTranscriptLines
  1511→	state.TurnCheckpointIDs = nil
  1512→}

  1514→// filesOverlap checks if any file in the committed set appears in filesTouched.
  1515→func filesOverlap(committed map[string]struct{}, filesTouched []string) bool {
  1516→	for _, f := range filesTouched {
  1517→		if _, ok := committed[f]; ok {
  1518→			return true
  1519→		}
  1520→	}
  1521→	return false
  1522→}

  1524→// hasOverlappingFiles checks if any file in stagedFiles appears in filesTouched.
  1525→func hasOverlappingFiles(stagedFiles, filesTouched []string) bool {
  1526→	touchedSet := make(map[string]bool)
  1527→	for _, f := range filesTouched {

  1530→
  1531→	for _, staged := range stagedFiles {

  1534→		}

  1536→	return false

  1539→// filesChangedInCommit returns the set of files changed in a commit by diffing against its parent.
  1540→func filesChangedInCommit(commit *object.Commit) map[string]struct{} {
  1541→	result := make(map[string]struct{})
  1542→
  1543→	commitTree, err := commit.Tree()
  1544→	if err != nil {
  1545→		return result
  1546→	}
  1547→
  1548→	var parentTree *object.Tree
  1549→	if commit.NumParents() > 0 {
  1550→		parent, err := commit.Parent(0)
  1551→		if err != nil {
  1552→			return result
  1553→		}
  1554→		parentTree, err = parent.Tree()
  1555→		if err != nil {
  1556→			return result
  1557→		}
  1558→	}
  1559→
  1560→	if parentTree == nil {
  1561→		// Initial commit — all files are new
  1562→		if iterErr := commitTree.Files().ForEach(func(f *object.File) error {
  1563→			result[f.Name] = struct{}{}
  1564→			return nil
  1565→		}); iterErr != nil {
  1566→			return result
  1567→		}
  1568→		return result
  1569→	}
  1570→
  1571→	changes, err := parentTree.Diff(commitTree)
  1572→	if err != nil {
  1573→		return result
  1574→	}
  1575→	for _, change := range changes {
  1576→		name := change.To.Name
  1577→		if name == "" {
  1578→			name = change.From.Name
  1579→		}
  1580→		result[name] = struct{}{}
  1581→	}
  1582→	return result
  1583→}

  1585→// subtractFiles returns files that are NOT in the exclude set.
  1586→func subtractFiles(files []string, exclude map[string]struct{}) []string {
  1587→	var remaining []string
  1588→	for _, f := range files {
  1589→		if _, excluded := exclude[f]; !excluded {
  1590→			remaining = append(remaining, f)
  1591→		}
  1592→	}
  1593→	return remaining
  1594→}

  1596→// carryForwardToNewShadowBranch creates a new shadow branch at the current HEAD
  1597→// containing the remaining uncommitted files and all session metadata.
  1598→// This enables the next commit to get its own unique checkpoint.
  1599→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) carryForwardToNewShadowBranch(
  1600→	logCtx context.Context,
  1601→	repo *git.Repository,
  1602→	state *SessionState,
  1603→	remainingFiles []string,
  1604→) {
  1605→	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
  1606→
  1607→	metadataDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(state.SessionID)
  1608→	metadataDirAbs := filepath.Join(state.WorktreePath, metadataDir)
  1609→
  1610→	result, err := store.WriteTemporary(context.Background(), checkpoint.WriteTemporaryOptions{
  1611→		SessionID:         state.SessionID,
  1612→		BaseCommit:        state.BaseCommit,
  1613→		WorktreeID:        state.WorktreeID,
  1614→		ModifiedFiles:     remainingFiles,
  1615→		MetadataDir:       metadataDir,
  1616→		MetadataDirAbs:    metadataDirAbs,
  1617→		CommitMessage:     "carry forward: uncommitted session files",
  1618→		IsFirstCheckpoint: false,
  1619→	})

  1621→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: carry-forward failed",
  1622→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1623→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1624→		)
  1625→		return
  1626→	}
  1627→	if result.Skipped {
  1628→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: carry-forward skipped (no changes)",
  1629→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1630→		)
  1631→		return
  1632→	}

  1635→	// CheckpointTranscriptStart = 0 is intentional: prompt-level carry-forward means
  1636→	// the next condensation re-processes the full transcript so the checkpoint is self-contained.
  1637→	state.FilesTouched = remainingFiles
  1638→	state.StepCount = 1
  1639→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = 0
  1640→	state.LastCheckpointID = ""
  1641→
  1642→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-commit: carried forward remaining files",
  1643→		slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
  1644→		slog.Int("remaining_files", len(remainingFiles)),
  1645→	)
  1646→}
